items.name: Granny's Apple Fries
items.description: Warm apple pieces in a crispy fried shell, cinnamon sugar, vanilla cream dip — the park's signature snack for two decades.
items.verdict: The single item most worth its queue at Legoland. Order one, split it, understand the ritual.

items.name: Carved turkey plate
items.description: Carved turkey with sides from the market cafeteria — the real-meal anchor of an in-park lunch.
items.verdict: Honest cafeteria food that beats the pizza line on quality and the burger line on speed. The parents' pick.

items.name: Kids' build-a-meal
items.description: The cafeteria's configurable kids' meal — main, sides and a drink chosen by the child, with allergy-safe substitutions.
items.verdict: The picky-eater solution. Letting the six-year-old assemble the plate is half the calories saved.
